import json
import numpy as np
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.db import Base,AutoLearnTask,TrainingSample,ModelVersion
from app.autolearn import service
engine=create_engine('sqlite:///:memory:');Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
with Session(engine,expire_on_commit=False) as db:
    task=service.create_task(db,name='QA_ONLY',visual_prompt='QA_ONLY probe',positive_label='occupied',negative_label='empty')
    for i in range(6):
        for j,label in enumerate(['occupied','empty']):
            db.add(TrainingSample(task_id=task.id,source_id=123,session_id='same-real-session',group_key=f'g{i}',image_path='QA_ONLY-no-file',image_hash=f'h{i}_{j}',verified=True,verified_label=label,verified_by='QA_ONLY',origin='qa_synthetic'))
    db.commit();old=service.build_split_plan(db,task)
    rows=db.query(TrainingSample).all()
    print(json.dumps({'probe':'same-session-arbitrary-groups','actual_sessions':list({r.session_id for r in rows}),'actual_sources':list({r.source_id for r in rows}),'accepted_splits':old.counts,'session_splits':list(set(old.assignments.values()))}))
    for r in rows:r.split=old.assignments[r.id]
    db.commit(); old_test={r.id for r in rows if r.split=='test'}; old_train={r.id for r in rows if r.split=='train'}
    mv=ModelVersion(task_id=task.id,version=1,artifact_path='QA_ONLY-mocked-loader',encoder_name='resnet18',encoder_weights_version='QA_ONLY',preprocess_version='QA_ONLY',class_mapping=old.class_mapping,dataset_hash=old.dataset_hash,split_hash=old.split_hash,train_count=old.counts['train'],val_count=old.counts['val'],test_count=old.counts['test'],threshold=.5,train_duration_ms=1,environment={'disclosure':'QA_ONLY mocked embeddings'},metrics={'f1':1,'support':old.counts['test']})
    db.add(mv);db.commit()
    found=None
    for n in range(1000):
        for j,label in enumerate(['occupied','empty']):
            db.add(TrainingSample(task_id=task.id,session_id=f'new-session-{n}',group_key=f'new-group-{n}',image_path='QA_ONLY-no-file',image_hash=f'new{n}_{j}',verified=True,verified_label=label,origin='qa_synthetic'))
        db.commit();new=service.build_split_plan(db,task)
        new_test={i for i,s in new.assignments.items() if s=='test'}
        if old_train & new_test:
            found={'new_group_index':n,'old_train_now_test':sorted(old_train&new_test),'original_test_ids':sorted(old_test),'new_test_ids':sorted(new_test)};break
    for r in db.query(TrainingSample).all():r.split=new.assignments[r.id]
    db.commit()
    class MockClassifier:
        def predict_proba(self,X):return X[:,0]
    service.student.StudentClassifier.load=lambda _:MockClassifier()
    service._embed=lambda rows:(np.asarray([[1 if r.verified_label=='occupied' else 0] for r in rows],dtype=np.float32),[1]*len(rows))
    actual=service.evaluate(db,mv)
    print(json.dumps({'probe':'old-version-reevaluation-after-retrain','disclosure':'mock classifier/embeddings solely to inspect row selection, not accuracy','membership':found,'stored_original_test_count':mv.test_count,'reevaluated_support':actual['support'],'retains_old_split_hash':mv.split_hash==old.split_hash}))
    remaining=db.query(TrainingSample).filter(TrainingSample.split=='test').all()
    # Simulates the legitimate shared-row reassignment during a later train;
    # narrow to one positive for an explicit gate-denominator contract check.
    for r in remaining:r.split='train'
    chosen=next(r for r in rows if r.verified_label=='occupied');chosen.split='test';db.commit()
    actual=service.evaluate(db,mv)
    print(json.dumps({'probe':'gate-uses-stale-support','disclosure':'unit boundary check with mocked embeddings; QA_ONLY rows','actual_evaluated_support':actual['support'],'gate':service.gate_status(mv)}))
